observations: I read in full the request JSON, works/auto-6294ee8a2094/source/original.txt, and docs/REVISION-AND-REVIEWS.md, docs/PROMPTS.md and docs/ART-QUALITY.md. I opened and looked at assets/panels/03-1.png, main-cast.png, vision-cast.png and workflow/review/page-03.png. I did not open the storyboard SVG page-03.svg itself; I used the composed review PNG for page context.

Ravi matches the sheet: narrow eyes creasing in a smile, thick straight brows, square jaw with a trimmed beard, side-parted short hair, light green shirt with rolled sleeves, dark trousers and a brown shoulder bag. His smile and open wave fit the 'Ravi arrives' beat and the source line 'Ravi arrives at reception.'

The hands match the production record. The raised waving hand on the viewer's left is his right and has five readable fingers. His left hand grips the bag strap on his left shoulder and wears the watch, so the watch is on the left wrist as specified.

Meera is seen over the shoulder in her blue block-print kurta, with the side braid, silver bangle and large round eyes. Only one typing hand is visible, and her left hand is hidden, so 'both hands typing' is only partly shown. This is acceptable for an over-the-shoulder shot.

The monitor faces the viewer and shows only abstract icons (calendar, person, check) and blank blocks. I found no readable text, logo or personal data. The glass door behind Ravi, the morning light and the waiting chairs with two figures seen from behind fit the scene text.

A dark-blue phone already lies on the reception desk before Ravi's hands are free. In 03-2 Ravi holds a phone that looks the same, so a reader may take this one for Meera's phone or be briefly unsure. This is minor and does not break the beat.
